data.title: 阿尔托莉雅 · 银杏长椅边的热茶
data.description: 秋日公园的银杏叶落在木长椅旁，阿尔托莉雅穿深蓝针织开衫、白衬衫和裙装坐在椅上，双膝自然并拢。她用双手捧住一只暖茶纸杯，轻轻低头靠近杯口，闻到茶香时露出很浅的笑。金色盘发上的蓝丝带随微风轻动，碧绿眼睛映着透过黄叶的斜阳；落叶小路在身后延伸。
data.location: 秋日公园银杏树下的木长椅
data.action: 双膝并拢坐在长椅上，两手捧暖茶纸杯，低头闻茶香。
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, seated environmental portrait
data.promptProse: Beneath yellow ginkgo leaves, a warm paper cup rests between Artoria Pendragon’s palms. Seated on a park bench with knees together, the Fate/stay night knight lowers her face toward the tea and smiles at its aroma. A dark-blue cardigan, white collared shirt and skirt replace her armor. Her green eyes catch the afternoon light; a blue ribbon moves beside the blonde braided bun and ahoge. The leaf-covered path recedes behind this single seated figure. Keep the cup unmarked and the hands visible.
